summary: Frontend-only UI polish verification for the 3 report pages (Sales Report, Vendor Reports, All-Outlets Sales). All PageHeaders render with correct titles ('Sales Report', 'Sales Report', 'Total Sales'). All FilterBar cards render with the 'Filters' overline. New date-mode pill chips are wired correctly: sales-mode-{range,date,month} switch inputs (sales-start-input/sales-end-input, sales-date-input, sales-month-input); filter-mode-{single,range,month} switch inputs (filter-single, filter-from+filter-to+preset-7/preset-30, filter-month); report-mode-{month,range,single} switch inputs (report-month, report-from+report-to, report-single). Old dropdown testids ('filter-mode', 'report-mode') are correctly removed. StatCards render on all three pages (sales-grand-total, sales-order-count on Sales; six KPI cards on Vendor Reports; four summary cards inside report-summary on All-Outlets). DataTables render (sales-by-city/client/customer-type/site/vendor, per-vendor-table, per-counter-table, per-payment-table). Vendor group toggle vendor-group-{site,vendor} present on Sales. Excel/CSV/PDF download buttons present; Sales xlsx download triggered (cravitoo-sales-2026-08-17_2026-09-16.xlsx) and All-Outlets xlsx download triggered (cravitoo_all_outlets_sales_2026-09-16.xlsx). No horizontal overflow at desktop 1920px or mobile 390px on any of the three pages (0px overflow each). Data populated for the operator/master with data (Total ₹330, 2 orders).
critical_code_review_comments: Sales Report cascading multi-selects receive `testid` props ('sales-filter-client/city/site/vendor/customer-type') but those testids do not appear in the DOM (query_selector returns null for all five). The MultiSelect component likely does not forward the `testid` prop to its root/trigger. UX/data works, but automated selection of these filters via data-testid is currently impossible. Consider forwarding testid to the trigger button in MultiSelect.
